1940, February
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten message by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
(WRITTEN ON THE FLYLEAF OF VOLUME TWO OF THE "MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD" BOOKS)
NEW YEARS DAY: -- A HAPPY NEW YEAR!
Dear Reader: --
"To know is to appreciate. " --
And "Gratitude for favors is one of the very first and Surest indications of intelligence."
God's greatest benefit to man, after his creation, was - his Redemption. The Incarnation of the Son of God was actual beginning of That Redemption.
The following pages give details seldom - if ever - found elsewhere regarding this mystery of love. They are details as given by our dear Bl. Mother in her own singlarly privileged "autobiography."
Only in Heaven will we ever be able to appreciate such details as they deserve to be appreciated.
Fr. Solanus, O. M. Cap.
P. S. In strict sense of the word "autobiography" is not exactly the one to use. Cur Bl. Mother herself refers to it (in the 4th book), as a work of the Highest Truth It is so much the Blessed Virgin's work, however, as the front piece in this (No. 2) would seem to indicate, -- instructing the writer and coaching her, etc., that it is not improperly called -- as above -- the Autobiography.
Copied from: Book - City of God Volumnes used by Father Solanus Now in Guild Office files Book No. 5
